{{Quote|Hr=SS
|Weaver of Pharloom. By grace you warded. By thread you healed. For your favour, eternal, we offer our song. 
|[[Mosshome]] [[Lore Tablets (Silksong)|Lore Tablet]]}}

<b>Weaver Effigies</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|tradable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are carved from bone and depict various [[Weavers|Weaver]] figures, with prayers dedicated to the specific Weaver etched onto the body of the figure. [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]] can decipher the prayer.

== Use ==
Can be sold to Relic Seeker Scrounge for {{R|150}}.

After sale, they can be read by visiting Relic Seeker Scrounge, or in the [[Bellhome]] after purchasing the [[Desk]].
